phases.name: phase 1 acclimation
phases.focus: establish technique and safe ramp in, maintain integrity and posture

phases.name: phase 2 progression
phases.focus: gradual load increase with controlled tempo and form

phases.name: phase 3 consolidation
phases.focus: maintain strength with pregnancy-safe variations and regressed loads

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-Week Pregnancy Strength Program"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain and adapt strength through pregnancy with safe progression"

PHASES
  PHASE "phase 1 acclimation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Strength Upper training 60m "Acclimation: technique and safe ramp"
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Strength Lower training 60m "Acclimation: technique, safe depth"
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Modifier/Technique 45m "Technique and bracing focus"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60s
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          thoracic_opening 2m
      DAY Active Recovery 30m "Light mobility and breathing"
        warmup:
          gentle_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_circles 2x10
          cat_cow 2x10
          pelvic_tilt 2x10
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Strength Upper training 60m "Technique refinement"
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Strength Lower training 60m "Controlled tempo"
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Modifier/Technique 45m "Bracing and posture"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60s
          renegade_row_variant 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Active Recovery 30m
        warmup:
          easy jog_in_place 5m
        main straight_sets:
          mobility flow 15m
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Strength Upper training 60m "Volume introduction with control"
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Strength Lower training 60m "Tempo work"
        warmup:
          leg_mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2m
      DAY Modifier/Technique 45m "Breathing, bracing, posture drill"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60s
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          thoracic_opening 2m
      DAY Active Recovery 30m
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          mobility sequence 15m
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Strength Upper training 60m "Progression with safe loads"
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Strength Lower training 60m "Strength maintenance"
        warmup:
          hip_mreasure 5m
        main straight_sets:
          sumo_deadlift 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120s
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          calfs 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Modifier/Technique 45m "Form checks and posture"
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_fly 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60s
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Active Recovery 30m
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5m
        main straight_sets:
          mobility flow 15m
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2m
  PHASE "phase 2 progression" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:

    WEEK 6:

      DAY Strength Lower training 60m "Posterior chain emphasis"
